_doc: Thính Vũ Lâu cast, part 1: the Nguyên Anh and the Kết Đan. Part 2 (thinh_vu.2.cast.json): the dead of the lineage and the Trúc Cơ. Part 3 (thinh_vu.3.cast.json): the Luyện Khí.

people.role: Head of Thính Vũ Lâu; proclaimed the Night Rain Edict and moved the halls onto the thunder ridge
people.appearance: A narrow man in a black oiled-silk rain cloak who keeps the spotted-bamboo umbrella furled at his side indoors, and turns his head toward a sound before he turns his eyes.
people.backstory: Mạnh Dạ Vũ was born in 700 in Thu Trì Thành, the son of a man who mended rain gutters for the inns. Phó Tiêu Tương (pho_tieu_tuong) took him into the Tower at twelve because he could tell, from the drip of the eaves, which room's guest was awake. In 880 he took the Tương Phi Tán and the Tower at 180 (C164). The Tower had lost the War of Broken Halberds with its founder in the field (C017), and the righteous sects had closed their markets to it. In 905 he opened its gates to the ma đạo masters nobody else would house (C167, C196), and they paid in arts and in fear. He kept Kinh Lôi Mạch against Phượng Minh (C179). He lost at Đan Sơn Mạch when the Pivot came in (C189, C190), and his Dao partner Kỷ Vãn Tình (ky_van_tinh) died holding the pass (N-thinh_vu-08). He did not leave the old tower for a year (A277). In 1166 he moved the halls east onto Thần Cổ Phong, above the vein and within sight of the Pivot's border (N-thinh_vu-09). Every rainy season he goes back alone to Văn Lôi Đài to listen.
people.wants: To see the North Star Compact broken without fighting a war he can lose, and to choose his heir before she chooses herself.
people.secret: At Đan Sơn Mạch he ordered Kỷ Vãn Tình's rear guard to hold the pass so the rest could withdraw, knowing the Pivot's arrays would close on it. Mạnh Lưu Ly is her daughter and his. He has told her neither thing.

people.role: War elder of Thính Vũ Lâu (age 560); came home at the Night Rain Edict in 906 and has never lost a duel
people.appearance: A tall, grey-haired woman with a smith's forearms and a miner's squint, who stands with her weight back and her sword hand always empty.
people.backstory: Cố Dạ Lan was born in 640 at Kinh Điện Khoáng, where Khải Lôi's smiths had forged in the storm (A281) and the miners still did. Her root was Metal and nothing else. At sixteen her father forged her a sword in a storm, and she left with it. For two hundred and fifty years she sold that sword across the continent, fought four hundred duels and lost none. She killed in duels with disciples of three righteous sects, and none of them would have her. When the Night Rain Edict opened the Tower (C167), she came home among the first masters (C196). Mạnh Dạ Vũ (manh_da_vu) gave her the War Hall and asked her nothing about her duels. She held the ridge forts through the Thunder Vein War (C178, C179). At Đan Sơn Mạch she asked to meet Doãn Ngọc Hành (doan_ngoc_hanh) alone, and the head forbade it (C189). She has not forgiven being forbidden, and she has not disobeyed. Since the halls came to the ridge in 1166 she has lived a month's walk from the mine she was born in.
people.wants: One duel with Doãn Ngọc Hành, or with the wandering sword sage Tư Không Hạc Niên: the only two swords left she has not measured.
people.secret: In 951 she stood at the door of the guest master Văn Hải Khô's seclusion cell while the head drained him and took the Hollow Tide Scripture. The Tower was told he died of a deviation. She would keep the door again.

people.role: Master of the soul vaults and keeper of Kinh Lôi Mạch (age 380); heads the Thunder Hall
people.appearance: A thin, stooped man with bronze-stained fingers and white eyebrows, who smells of lamp oil and speaks so quietly that people lean in.
people.backstory: Lệ Tiêu Hồn was born in 820 in Thanh Đăng Trấn, the lamp-makers' town under the Tower's cone, to a bronze-caster who made the Tower's lamps. The founder (pho_tieu_tuong) took him in 836 for his Thunder, which came from Fire and Metal in equal parts. When the Night Rain Edict put out the Tower's lamps (A274), the town lost its trade, and by 930 his family had gone to Hạnh Hoa Thị (V148). He went down instead into the soul vaults, where the only lamps the Tower still lights burn: one for each sworn member, each holding a thread of its owner's soul. He reached Nguyên Anh there in 1010, and the head made him keeper of Kinh Lôi Mạch (C199). He held the vein through the Thunder Vein War (C178, C179). In 1170 he moved the vaults into the vein under the new seat and laid the Iron Rain array along Thạch Liên Hoàn's chain (N-thinh_vu-10). He reads the Heavenly Tribulation Scripture and the third of Khải Lôi's canon that the Tower keeps sealed, and he is looking for the rest.
people.wants: The Xuân Lôi Cổ and the rest of Khải Lôi's canon, sealed inside the ridge in 470 (C035), and with them a way through his own tribulation.
people.secret: He has lit a lamp for the head. He took the hair for it in 1156, while Mạnh Dạ Vũ lay wounded after Đan Sơn Mạch. The vault law says a head has no lamp, and no one else knows this one burns.

people.role: First elder of Thính Vũ Lâu (age 420); keeper of the old tower, the founder's grave and the south
people.appearance: A silver-haired woman with a soft voice and a straight back, who wears nine spare bronze links at her belt and an old straw rain hat she will not replace.
people.backstory: Quan Vũ Thanh was born in 780 in Không Mông Thành, the city of hazy rain that Khải Lôi built and Thính Vũ inherited (C056). Her father read the rain gauges for the grain tax. The founder (pho_tieu_tuong) took her at ten. At twenty-three she carried the founder's umbrella onto the plain at Chiết Kích Nguyên (C017) and watched ten thousand die in a day, and she has spoken for peace ever since. She stood beside the founder at the truce (C018, C161) and became first elder under Mạnh Dạ Vũ (manh_da_vu), though she argued against the Night Rain Edict and lost. When the halls moved east in 1166 (N-thinh_vu-09) she stayed in the old tower with the founder's grave and the founder's rain-chain, and she governs the south from it: Thu Trì, the cities and four of the vassals. In 1185 she went to Phượng Minh in secret to talk of peace (A278). The Tower was told she came back without an answer.
people.wants: A peace with Phượng Minh before her years run out, and the Tower's halls brought home to the rain.
people.secret: Phượng Minh did answer. Its first elder Vu Ngô Đồng gave her terms in 1185: peace for a fifth of Kinh Lôi Mạch's yield. She knew the head would refuse and would use the offer as proof of weakness, so she has kept the terms in her sleeve for fifteen years.

people.role: The head's disciple, age 140, ambitious; rival of her master for the sect's future; the only root in the Tower that can hold the whole lineage
people.appearance: Small and quick, with skin so pale the veins show blue at her temples, and a sword of thin violet glass that hums before every storm.
people.backstory: Mạnh Lưu Ly was born in 1060 in Thu Trì Thành to Kỷ Vãn Tình (ky_van_tinh), and Mạnh Dạ Vũ (manh_da_vu) took her as his disciple the same year (A276). She carries his surname as his disciple, and the Tower does not ask why. Her root formed Thunder at nine. It holds Metal, Fire and Water together, which no one else in the Tower has: the head's sutra needs Water, the canon's second half needs Thunder, and she can open both. Her meridians are thin as glass. She cultivates fast and breaks often, and she reached Kết Đan at 130 on pills and stubbornness. At Đan Sơn Mạch (C190) she was 96 and in the main column when her mother's rear guard was lost (N-thinh_vu-08). Since the move to the ridge she has gathered the young Thunder disciples around her on Liệt Khuyết Phong. Quan Vũ Thanh (quan_vu_thanh) half raised her and still calls her by her milk name.
people.wants: To be head while her master is alive to watch it, and to hold the whole lineage, sutra and canon, as no one has since the founder.
people.secret: She found her mother's letters in 1157. She knows she is the head's daughter, and she knows who ordered the rear guard to hold. She has decided nothing yet, and her master does not know she knows.

people.role: Mistress of the Hall of Echoes: the Tower's ears in every inn of the south, and its judge of spies
people.appearance: A plain, heavy-lidded woman in grey who sits with her head tilted toward the nearest door, a small bronze bell sewn inside her collar.
people.backstory: Nhiếp Vô Thanh was born in 880 in Hạnh Hoa Thị, the year the founder died (C164), into the family that has kept the Tower's Hall of Echoes since her grandfather Nhiếp Văn Lôi (nhiep_van_loi) began it. The Nhiếp are the Tower's ears: innkeepers, ferrymen and lamp-sellers across the south who repeat what they hear to one woman. The innkeepers of Thu Trì who learned not to ask a stranger's name (A313) learned it from her mother. She took the Hall in 1010 and swore the family oath to report to the head alone. She judges as well as listens. The Hall of Echoes tries the Tower's spies and traitors, and she has sent eleven of them to the soul vaults. Since the Pivot's count of 1165 (C200) she has known which of the Tower's clerks counts for Thiên Xu. She has done nothing about him, which the head takes for patience. In 1199 she stopped the copper to Vũ Linh Đường, whose mistress's bells have heard her own listeners for fifty years; her price is the line and the book.
people.wants: To keep the Tower out of a war with the Pivot that it would lose, without breaking her oath to a head who wants that war.
people.secret: She has kept the Pivot's clerk Tào Mặc Toán alive since 1166 and uses him as a channel. For thirty years she has sent Doãn Ngọc Hành true numbers and true intentions, so that the Pivot never panics and never strikes first. By the letter of her oath it is treason.

people.role: True disciple of the Thunder Hall; a ridge-born Thunder who claims Khải Lôi's blood
people.appearance: Broad and sunburnt, scarred from the left ear to the collarbone in a white fern of lightning, with a peach-wood drumstick pushed through his belt.
people.backstory: Hầu Vọng Xuân was born in 1080 at Tử Tinh Khoáng, the amethyst mine on the thunder ridge, into a miners' family that has kept a drumstick of thunder-struck peach wood for seven hundred years and says it was Hầu Xuân Lôi's (hau_xuan_loi). The family had always been Metal. He was born with Fire as well, and on that ridge a root with both forms Thunder almost every time. Lệ Tiêu Hồn (le_tieu_hon) took him at twelve. At twenty a bolt on Liệt Khuyết Phong left the fern on his neck and woke something in his blood that the vault lamps flicker for. He reached Kết Đan in 1178, eight years after the Tower came to the ridge (N-thinh_vu-09), the first of the new seat's own Thunder to do it. Every Kinh Trập he climbs the peak in the first storm (A316) and walks the ridge with the drumstick for a month afterwards.
people.wants: To open the realm Hầu Xuân Lôi sealed in 470 (C035), take the Xuân Lôi Cổ and the rest of Khải Lôi's canon, and raise the Gate That Opens the Thunder again, inside the Tower or out of it.
people.secret: The drumstick hums near three places on the ridge. He has told his master about one.

people.role: Master of the Night Rain Market in Thu Trì Thành; the Tower's purse
people.appearance: A plump man in a black rain cloak lined with red silk, an iron abacus at his hip and a different ring on every finger.
people.backstory: Kiều Mãn Lâu was born in 860 above his father's inn in Thu Trì Thành. When strangers in black came up the forest road at night after the Night Rain Edict (A313), the inn took their money and asked nothing, and Mạnh Dạ Vũ (manh_da_vu) noticed. He made Kiều master of the Night Rain Market when it opened (C198), and in fifty years the Tower's treasury doubled. Kiều sells ma đạo pills, poisons and arts under a roof that opens only after dark and only in rain (A315). In dry years he hires Cốc Vũ Quán to call rain. Since 1198 his best-selling paper has been Họa Tinh Đường's Dipper talisman, forged in deer glue at the Tower's coast house (hoang_tieu_diep): half the Hall's price, and the same gates.
people.wants: The whole of Họa Tinh's rain-fast stroke by next spring, so that his Dipper needs no glue and no nose can tell it from the Hall's.
people.secret: He gives the Tower's couriers their forged Dipper talismans for nothing, and this year they have passed three of the Pivot's gates on them.

people.backstory: Phương Đoạn Vũ was born in 990 at Vũ Hoa Khoáng, the rain-flower pebble mine the Tower keeps (A286). Cố Dạ Lan (co_da_lan) took him for his Metal and made him the War Hall's drillmaster. He drills the inner gate on Liệt Khuyết Phong in thunderstorms (A316) and counts the lightning with the villagers. At Đan Sơn Mạch he was in Kỷ Vãn Tình's rear guard (N-thinh_vu-08) and was one of four who came out, because she sent them. He has never told Mạnh Lưu Ly what her mother's last order was.

people.backstory: Hứa Thanh Diêm was born in 1010 in Không Mông Thành, like Quan Vũ Thanh (quan_vu_thanh), and like her she was taken for her ear for rain. Quan taught her; the record names the head. She is the Tower's envoy to the south and to the vassals, and she went with Quan to Phượng Minh in 1185 (A278). She was in the room when Vu Ngô Đồng gave his answer. She writes to him still, about tea. She still keeps his letters in a tea caddy.

people.backstory: Tưởng Lậu Thanh was born in 900 in Thảo Lư Thôn, among the herders who began keeping their lamp shutters closed on the side facing the Tower's cone (V147). He keeps the Tower's water clock and its rules: no lamp after dark, no name asked of a guest, no second cut where one will do. He runs the Kinh Trập Bell Test that moves outer disciples inward. Mạnh Dạ Vũ (manh_da_vu) gave him the Hall of Rules in 1050. Nhiếp Vô Thanh judges traitors and he judges everyone else, and they quarrel over the line.

people.role: Grand elder; one of the founder's four living disciples, keeper of the withered lotus and the lake graves of Tàn Hà Hồ
people.appearance: A tiny, brown old woman who sits on the lake shore in every rain without a hat, her hands folded in her sleeves.
people.backstory: Lư Tàn Hà was born in 722 in Thảo Lư Thôn and is one of the founder's four living disciples, twenty-two years from the end of her span. She keeps the withered lotus on Tàn Hà Hồ that Phó Tiêu Tương (pho_tieu_tuong) kept to hear the rain on (A266), the founder's grave beneath it, and every disciple sunk in the lake since. When the halls moved east (N-thinh_vu-09) she said only that a lake cannot be carried. Her Fire and Metal never formed Thunder, and she has never minded.

people.backstory: Ô Thiềm Tử was born in 950 in Độc Thiềm Lâm, the poison toad wood west of the Tower, and raised by a toad-catcher who sold venom to whoever paid. He came up the road in 966 because the Night Rain Edict (C167) meant no one at the Tower would ask what he brewed. He makes the pills and poisons Kiều Mãn Lâu (kieu_man_lau) sells, and some that Nghê Hồng Đậu buys. The healer Giả Hồi Xuân cures what he makes, so he sends her every new poison first.

people.role: Keeper of the life lamps in the soul vaults; holds the wick shears
people.appearance: A tall woman with ink on her fingers and wax in her hair, who blinks slowly in daylight after a month underground.
people.backstory: Ninh Tịch Đăng was born in 960 in Hạnh Hoa Thị to the lamp-makers who had left Thanh Đăng Trấn (V148); Lệ Tiêu Hồn (le_tieu_hon) is her mother's brother. He took her into the soul vaults at fourteen to write the names on the lamps. She trims every life lamp on the first night of each month and has written four thousand names. By the vault law her shears and his lamp are both needed to put a lamp out from afar. In 1177 he asked her to cut a deserter's wick, and she refused.
